document_id: PWC 2015 - Updated estimates on cost of Storm Desmond

impacts.description: Damage caused by Storm Desmond estimated at £400m - £500m

evidence.quote: Our current estimate of the damage caused by Storm Desmond is £400m - £500m

impacts.description: Insurance industry paying out between £250m and £325m

evidence.quote: with the insurance industry paying out between £250m and £325m
This compares to an economic cost of £275m

impacts.description: Potential for additional flash flooding to worsen damage

evidence.quote: Any additional rainfall - even 1cm-2cm - could cause flash flooding in rain affected areas as the ground is already saturated with water. This could compound the damage that has already been caused by Storm Desmond.
